data.display_address: Ellington House III, Dubai Hills Estate, Dubai
data.long_description:
Set within the prestigious Dubai Hills Estate, Ellington House III offers a blend of modern luxury and sustainable living. Developed by Ellington Properties, renowned for their stylish designs and high-quality finishes, this residential building features 9 floors dedicated to contemporary living.

With a podium level that boasts a swimming pool and a landscaped garden, residents can enjoy both relaxation and stunning views of the Dubai Hills Golf Club. The building offers a range of studios and 1-4 bedroom apartments, all designed with bright interiors to create an airy, spacious ambiance.

Finance is available on this property through Premier Property Finance. Call us on +97143233609 for a free consultation.
